title: Calibration
description: trajectory/profiles/calibration.json — the measured numbers exp000 produces. The adapter READS this file at runtime for stage budgets and noise floors; the agent WRITES it exactly once (exp000) and never hand-edits it after Phase-1 starts. This exists because the agent is forbidden from editing adapter.py — measured state lives in the trajectory, not in code.

s1_epochs.description: Stage-1 screening budget. Roughly 1/3 of s2_epochs, from the exp000 curve.

s2_epochs.description: Stage-2 full budget: just past where the exp000 vanilla val-mAP50 slope flattens.

noise_floor_s1_map50.description: max-min mAP50 spread across >=3 vanilla seeds at the S1 budget.

noise_floor_s2_map50.description: max-min mAP50 spread across >=3 vanilla seeds at the S2 budget.

measured_by.description: The experiment that produced these numbers (normally 'exp000').

working.description: Seeds the noise floors were measured on.

confirmation.description: Sealed P11 seeds whose baseline legs exp000 also ran.

epoch_probe_curve.description: Optional: the per-epoch mAP50 curve from the generous-cap probe run, so the s2_epochs choice can be audited later.
